name: jev-model-router
description: Picks the model and the reasoning effort for each task with TypeSafe's Jev, a System One decision model reached either through TypeSafe's own API or the Vercel AI Gateway. Routes subagent models at agent.spawn and the main loop's effort and model at turn.step, in both directions, falling back to the engine's built-in classifier when no key is set.

policyEngine.title: Routing policy engine
policyEngine.description: Legacy is the default. V2 uses dimension-based configured routing; shadow retains legacy execution. Context and ordinary execution limits are managed by the host.

routeSubagentEffort.title: Allow v2 subagent effort routing
routeSubagentEffort.description: Independent v2 effort permission applied at the child first request. Legacy does not apply subagent effort.

reviewMode.title: Independent review mode
reviewMode.description: Review preference only. Explicit composer checkpoints authorize bounded stages; automatic additionally requires exact trusted candidate/stage grants. Changing mode alone never launches work.

persistentModelPin.title: Persistent execution model pin
persistentModelPin.description: Exact execution model ID, not a reviewer choice. Trusted user/managed-policy sources only; applied by v2, staged under legacy/shadow.

persistentEffortPin.title: Persistent execution effort pin
persistentEffortPin.description: Named execution effort, not a reviewer choice. Respects routing switches and eligibility; applied by v2, staged under legacy/shadow.

verificationChecksJson.title: Trusted verification check definitions
verificationChecksJson.description: Versioned check definitions from observable user or managed-policy settings only. Project/local/flag values grant no authority. Commands run only at authorized candidate checkpoints; unknown Bash completion never certifies a pass.

typesafeApiKey.title: TypeSafe API key
typesafeApiKey.description: Key for TypeSafe's own API; preferred over the Gateway, since only it reports a calibrated confidence

gatewayApiKey.title: Vercel AI Gateway API key
gatewayApiKey.description: Key for the AI Gateway; with none set the engine's built-in classifier is used instead

provider.title: Backend
provider.description: Which backend to use; "auto" picks TypeSafe when its key is set, then the Gateway, then the built-in classifier

typesafeBaseUrl.title: TypeSafe base URL
typesafeBaseUrl.description: Base URL of TypeSafe's own API; empty uses https://api.typesafe.ai

typesafeModel.title: TypeSafe model
typesafeModel.description: Decision model on TypeSafe's own API; empty uses jev-latest

gatewayBaseUrl.title: AI Gateway base URL
gatewayBaseUrl.description: Base URL of the AI Gateway; empty uses https://ai-gateway.vercel.sh/v4/ai

gatewayModel.title: AI Gateway model
gatewayModel.description: Decision model on the AI Gateway; empty uses typesafe-ai/jev

fastModel.title: Fast tier
fastModel.description: Model alias or id for mechanical, local tasks

balancedModel.title: Balanced tier
balancedModel.description: Model alias or id for ordinary engineering work

deepModel.title: Deep tier
deepModel.description: Model alias or id for hard or high-stakes work

minUpgradeConfidence.title: Confidence to spend more
minUpgradeConfidence.description: How sure the decision must be to raise the model or the effort; being wrong here costs money, so the bar is low

minDowngradeConfidence.title: Confidence to spend less
minDowngradeConfidence.description: How sure it must be to lower the model or the effort; being wrong here means a task gets too little, so the bar is high

routeSubagentModel.title: Route subagent models
routeSubagentModel.description: Pick each subagent model at agent.spawn; v2 effort is separately controlled at the child first request.

routeMainEffort.title: Route the main loop's effort
routeMainEffort.description: Raise or lower the reasoning effort of the main conversation

routeMainModel.title: Route the main loop's model
routeMainModel.description: Change the model of the main conversation; off by default because switching models mid-session invalidates the prompt cache

timeoutMs.title: Latency budget (ms)
timeoutMs.description: How long to wait for a decision before letting the request through unchanged

logDecisions.title: Log decisions
logDecisions.description: Show the effective model and effort per turn; keep classifier recommendations and diagnostics in the debug log.

taskRoutingMode.title: Task routing mode
taskRoutingMode.description: Basic uses fast/balanced/deep routing. Custom uses our task preferences with Basic fallback. Observe keeps Basic routing active and only logs what Custom would pick. All respect routing switches. Edit hooks/task-routing.ts for rules/examples and catalog/models.json for model capabilities; then run node scripts/build-catalog.mjs.

taskMinConfidence.title: Task classification confidence
taskMinConfidence.description: Minimum confidence for applying a task-role preference

orchestrationModel.title: orchestrationModel
orchestrationModel.description: Preferred catalog model ID for this role or implementation category

visualAnalysisModel.title: visualAnalysisModel
visualAnalysisModel.description: Preferred catalog model ID for this role or implementation category

designLedModel.title: designLedModel
designLedModel.description: Preferred catalog model ID for this role or implementation category

specifiedModel.title: specifiedModel
specifiedModel.description: Preferred catalog model ID for this role or implementation category

mechanicalModel.title: mechanicalModel
mechanicalModel.description: Preferred catalog model ID for this role or implementation category

fileScoutModel.title: fileScoutModel
fileScoutModel.description: Preferred catalog model ID for this role or implementation category

classifyTurns.title: Per-turn classification and logging
classifyTurns.description: Classify main prompts and log recommendations even when main model and effort routing are disabled

simpleAnswerModel.title: Simple answers & chat model
simpleAnswerModel.description: Legacy Custom uses this for simple facts. V2 also routes confident standalone greetings and thanks here, preferring low effort where configured. Continuations/approvals are not chat; switches and pins still apply.

v2ShadowClassifier.title: Opt into v2 shadow classification
v2ShadowClassifier.description: Additional dimension-classifier calls in shadow mode, only when explicitly set in observable user or managed-policy settings. Does not enable dispatch, pins, checks or reviews.

reviewPolicyJson.title: Bounded review policy and scoped automatic grants
reviewPolicyJson.description: User/managed-policy only. Manual review uses one fresh tool-less completion with finite output tokens and timeout. Automatic spending requires exact candidate/stage grants; mode alone is not authorization. Repair writes only enrolled finding paths.

explanationModel.title: V2 explanation model
explanationModel.description: V2 saved default. Teaching concepts and comparing known ideas; not external research or source condensation.

writingModel.title: V2 writing model
writingModel.description: V2 saved default. Creating/editing original non-code prose and documents. New architecture decisions are planning.

structuredTextModel.title: V2 source-grounded text model
structuredTextModel.description: V2 saved default. Summarization, translation and structured extraction from supplied content; requests low effort, not unverified external facts.

researchModel.title: V2 research model
researchModel.description: V2 saved default. Gathering and verifying current/external evidence. Extended work uses the long-horizon preference.

analysisModel.title: V2 analysis and review model
analysisModel.description: V2 saved default. Bounded diagnosis, quantitative analysis and ordinary artifact review. Does not select independent workflow reviewers or grant extra calls.

planningModel.title: V2 planning model
planningModel.description: V2 saved default. Plans, strategy and architecture without implementation or agent coordination; extended work uses the long-horizon preference.

operationsModel.title: V2 operations model
operationsModel.description: V2 saved default. Executing or inspecting existing workflows/tools, not authoring code. Host permissions and consequential-work constraints still apply.

longHorizonModel.title: V2 long-horizon model
longHorizonModel.description: V2 saved default. Extended multi-step work. Opus medium by default; selecting claude-fable-5-1 requests high effort and requires an available compatible path. No implicit fallback grant.
